collectionMethodology: Curated supervised instruction examples derived from reviewed documentation and general AI/ML engineering principles. Each example is designed around a user task, diagnostic decision, terminology distinction, or documentation authority rule. Records use one JSON object per line with messages in system/user/assistant order. Keep source provenance in a companion audit manifest if the active compiler schema does not permit additional fields. Validate factual support, JSONL schema, duplicate and semantic leakage, source-version compatibility, and held-out task performance before training.
